confirmedDecisions: The global app bar owns main-screen navigation, Settings, keyboard-map access, and the combined Activity and Errors surface.
The existing activity-history concept expands to include persistent errors and technical details; errors do not receive a separate global button.
The activity/status control is visually separate from the adjacent keyboard-map and Settings controls.
Each main screen may own an optional command bar in a consistent slot inside the central workspace.
Side-panel controls remain in their own panel headers.
The keyboard map is globally accessible and combines Global shortcuts with shortcuts for the active screen.
Shortcut assignments are presented as read-only keycaps and do not imply remapping.
Activity history supports wheel and keyboard navigation without permanent scrollbar chrome.
